elements.content: Master the core scientific vocabulary and collocations for this topic (10 items):

items.definition: to rest your body on a chair.
items.example: Try to sit up straight while reading.

items.definition: in a direct line; not curved or bent.
items.example: A straight back helps you breathe better.

items.definition: the way you feel at a particular time.
items.example: A walk in the sun can improve your mood.

items.definition: the rear part of the human body from the neck to the hips.
items.example: Sitting slouched causes pain in your lower back.

items.definition: a seat for one person, typically with four legs and a back.
items.example: Choose a comfortable chair for your desk.

items.definition: the strength required for sustained physical or mental activity.
items.example: Sitting straight gives you more daily energy.

items.definition: the center of interest or activity.
items.example: Good posture helps students focus on lessons.

items.definition: the physical structure of a human.
items.example: Your body language shows how you feel inside.

items.definition: the state of being free from illness or injury.
items.example: Daily stretches are good for back health.

items.definition: to become less tense and more calm.
items.example: Take a deep breath to relax your shoulders.
